source_text.body:
Use a personal agent for research and calling the dentist
The poster used Grok 4.6 through Hermes Agent as a personal assistant; it called the dentist but the research went poorly and they ended up doing it themselves.
·
Sep 19, 2026
Done with
HA
Hermes Agent
What they did
The poster says they used Grok 4.6 through Hermes Agent as a personal assistant and let it handle both research and a dentist phone call. In the examples they gave, the agent researched something but returned the wrong answer, so they did the research themselves, and on the call it failed to include basics like their birthday because that information was missing from the packet they had provided.
How it went
It had worked correctly on calls before, but in this instance the poster says they had to correct it several times in one day. The outcome was poor enough that they finished the research manually and were frustrated that the call left out needed details.
Worth knowing
The clearest catch is that the calling agent only passed along what was in the packet, so missing personal details caused the failure.
Try it yourself
with
Hermes Agent
Copy prompt
Help me with two tasks. First, research [topic or decision, e.g. dentists near me that accept my insurance] and give me a short comparison with sources, saying clearly how confident you are in each claim. Second, prepare a call script and the details needed to book [appointment type] with [business name], including my availability of [dates and times]. Before you place any call or confirm any booking, show me the script and wait for my approval.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/grok/comments/1w5dwf5/has_grok_46_gone_dumb
